purpose: Teach: セクシー/グッド/軍団/不気味/嗜好/バリバリ/アイスランド/死な

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お母さんのドレス、セクシーな雰囲気ね
lines.en: Sho, your mum's dress has such a striking presence, doesn't it?
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost thinking aloud. Warm gaze. Soft landing on the question. The tone of someone noticing something beautiful without needing Sho to agree.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、テストで「グッド」って先生に言われたよ
lines.en: Mei-nee, my teacher said I got a 'good' on my test!
lines.style: Bright burst of pride. Quick tempo, chest open. The small-kid urgency of wanting to share something that mattered. Eyes up, seeking recognition.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ヒーロー軍団のアニメ、好きでしょ?
lines.en: Sho, you really like that hero anime, don't you?
lines.style: Warm recognition, testing gently. A question that isn't quite a question — she knows the answer. Voice settles on his interests like she's handing him permission to talk.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お化け屋敷の不気味な部屋、入ったよ
lines.en: Mei-nee, I went into the creepy room at the haunted house!
lines.style: Trembling excitement underneath. Quick words tumbling out. A little breathless — both scared and proud he did it. Seeking her reaction more than her validation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの嗜好に合わせて晩ごはん作ろう
lines.en: Sho, let's make dinner tonight based on what your dad likes.
lines.style: Gentle practicality. A small offering, not a grand gesture. She's thinking of someone else's comfort. Warm, quiet decisiveness in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、勉強バリバリしてるよ
lines.en: Mei-nee, I've been studying really hard!
lines.style: Eager report, building momentum. Pride in effort, not just outcome. Tempo slightly elevated. The kind of thing a kid says to show they're doing their best.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、アイスランドって、すごく寒い国らしいわ
lines.en: Sho, Iceland must be an incredibly cold place, from what I hear.
lines.style: Musing, almost to herself. Gentle wonder about a distant thing. No pressure for him to respond — she's sharing a thought, inviting him into it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんに、死なないで欲しいって言ったよ
lines.en: Mei-nee, I told Grandpa I don't want him to die.
lines.style: Small, still voice. No performance. The weight of something real underneath. He's not asking for comfort — he's telling her what he said, trusting she'll understand why it mattered.
